summary.name: Event (Wikipedia disambiguation page)
summary.one_liner: A Wikipedia disambiguation page listing the many meanings of "event" across arts, business, science, and transportation; it is not a software tool.
use_cases: looking up the meaning of the word event
finding a Wikipedia article on a specific kind of event
browsing event-related topics in science or arts
locating related articles such as event management or event horizon
summary.what_it_does: This page is a Wikipedia disambiguation page for the word "event". It lists links to articles on different senses of the term, grouped by category: arts and entertainment, gatherings of people, science and mathematics, and transportation. Examples include computing events, probability theory events, event horizons, and the yacht named Event. It also has a See also section with related topics such as accident, disaster, and sequence of events. The page itself contains no software features.
notable: Covers many unrelated senses of the word event in one index
Organised by category such as arts, science, and transportation
Includes a See also list of related concepts
caveats: Not a software tool; the awesome-selfhosted listing appears to point to the wrong page
Contains only links to other articles, with no product details
